mapper.sql: id, batch_no, plan_id, quantity, channel, expires_at, status, created_by, created_at

where.if: AND ( batch.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR batch.channel LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR plan.plan_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redeem_code_batch ( batch_no, plan_id, quantity, channel, expires_at, status, created_by ) VALUES ( #{batchNo}, #{planId}, #{quantity}, #{channel}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM redeem_code_batch WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redeem_code_batch batch INNER JOIN product_plan plan ON plan.id = batch.plan_id

SELECT batch.id, batch.batch_no, batch.plan_id, plan.plan_name, plan.duration_days, batch.quantity, COALESCE(code_stats.unused_quantity, 0) AS unused_quantity, COALESCE(code_stats.redeemed_quantity, 0) AS redeemed_quantity, COALESCE(code_stats.disabled_quantity, 0) AS disabled_quantity, batch.channel, batch.status, batch.expires_at, batch.created_by, batch.created_at FROM redeem_code_batch batch INNER JOIN product_plan plan ON plan.id = batch.plan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS unused_quantity, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS redeemed_quantity, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS disabled_quantity FROM redeem_code GROUP BY batch_id ) code_stats ON code_stats.batch_id = batch.id
ORDER BY batch.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
